game.name: Nhl 12 (USA)
game.desc: NHL 12 on Xbox 360 is an ice hockey simulation offering, among other things, the chance to play as a legend like Wayne Gretzki, Mario Lemieux or Patrick Roy. The Be of Pro or Be a GM modes are also part of the game, as well as the Winter Classic, an outdoor game played in front of over 60,000 spectators. Dynamic contact management, an AI that anticipates your movements and fights between players or goalkeepers top off the game.
